items.title: I finally tried XREAL's fully-baked Android XR glasses, and now I'm counting down to launch
items.excerpt: Android Authority went hands-on with XREAL's Aura, the first fully-realized Android XR glasses, arguing the Gemini-driven eyewear points to an Android you use without pulling out a phone screen.

items.title: The new W4 Plus is Timekettle’s most capable AI interpreter earbuds yet
items.excerpt: Timekettle's W4 Plus earbuds add real-time two-way AI interpretation, positioning live translation as a core hardware feature rather than a phone-app add-on.

items.title: I just went hands-on with the Odyss N1 — a sleek AI necklace that automatically tracks everything you eat
items.excerpt: Hands-on with the Odyss N1, an AI necklace whose on-body sensing automatically logs every meal you eat — a passive-capture wearable aimed at replacing manual food tracking.

items.title: This tiny AI box could save me from upgrading my perfectly good laptop
items.excerpt: At IFA 2026, Tom's Guide tried Violoop, a small external AI box that brings capable local AI agents to an older laptop instead of forcing a new machine purchase.

items.title: I test smart glasses for a living, and the RayNeo GT Max could be the best I’ve seen in 2026 so far for one important reason
items.excerpt: TechRadar says RayNeo's GT Max delivers Xreal One Pro-class display tech at roughly a third of the price, a sign that AI-era display glasses are entering mainstream pricing.

items.title: DJI's second-gen Romo robot vacuum looks like the lovechild of an HR Giger drawing and an iMac G3
items.excerpt: DJI's second-gen Romo robot vacuum borrows drone navigation know-how for precise mapping, and adds hardware privacy measures after the first generation's hacking embarrassment.

items.title: This new robot lawn mower comes with its own infrared hedgehog-spotter — and a handy approach to edge-trimming
items.excerpt: The Anthbot R7 robot mower uses infrared sensing to spot hedgehogs at night and an extending trimmer arm to cut edges — perception hardware repurposed for garden safety.

items.title: I Watched a Stain-Removing Robot Completley Miss Its Target at IFA
items.excerpt: CNET watched Ecovacs' new stain-removing home robot miss its target at IFA 2026 — a candid look at the gap between AI home-robot demos and real reliability.

items.title: I Watched a Floor Washing Robot Mothership Deploy a Roomba Using a Mechnical Arm
items.excerpt: CNET saw a floor-washing 'mothership' robot deploy a Roomba-style unit with a mechanical arm at IFA 2026, one of the show's boldest multi-robot home concepts.

items.title: Withings' 'Thermometer of the Future' Is Getting an AI Analysis Upgrade
items.excerpt: Withings' BeamO multi-scope device gains an AI analysis layer that interprets its own heart and lung recordings, pushing consumer health hardware toward on-device interpretation.

items.title: GMKtec unveils EVO-X5 Pro at IFA 2026: A compact powerhouse with 192 GB RAM built for local AI
items.excerpt: GMKtec's EVO-X5 Pro mini PC pairs AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with 192GB of memory, built specifically to run large AI models locally on a desk-sized box.

items.title: Acemate unveils S10 Pro tennis robot with upgraded AI and Ace+ Shot ball handling
items.excerpt: Acemate's S10 Pro tennis robot upgrades its AI ball handling and shot placement, tracking and challenging players across clay, grass and hard courts.

items.title: Acer C350e Full HD projector debuts with cute design, AI Badge remote control, and Google Gemini
items.excerpt: Acer's C350e portable projector arrives in duckling-yellow with a rotating stand and a Google Gemini 'AI Badge' remote, putting an assistant button on a projector.

items.title: Apple Planning AI Home Security Camera and Service for 2027
items.excerpt: Bloomberg reports Apple is building a privacy-forward home security camera and service for 2027 that uses AI to interpret the surrounding environment rather than streaming raw video.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Comes to CarPlay
items.excerpt: Anthropic added CarPlay support to the Claude iOS app, so drivers can talk to Claude through in-car infotainment now that iOS 26.4 opens CarPlay to third-party chatbots.

items.title: Lenovo ThinkCentre X Ultra packs Gorgon Halo — AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 shows up in mini workstation
items.excerpt: Lenovo's ThinkCentre X Ultra packs AMD's Gorgon Halo Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with up to 128GB of unified memory, a mini workstation aimed at running big models on-desk.

items.title: Stripped-down Windows 11 for AI developers demands 64GB RAM and insane 250 GB/s bandwidth — Project Zenith will debut on AMD's flagship Ryzen AI Halo platform
items.excerpt: Microsoft's stripped-down Windows 11 'Project Zenith' for AI developers demands 64GB of RAM and 250 GB/s of bandwidth, debuting on AMD's Ryzen AI Halo platform.

items.title: The US Robot Ban Is Screwing Us Out of the Good Robomowers
items.excerpt: US import rules are keeping the newest robot mowers — including models with dedicated edge-trimming arms — out of American yards, Gizmodo reports.

items.title: Xiaomi just showed off its Galaxy Z Fold 8 competitor at IFA 2026
items.excerpt: Xiaomi used IFA 2026 to tease its wide foldable and to press its case for AI as the connective layer across its whole device ecosystem.

items.title: Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 could get offline Gemini
items.excerpt: Wear OS 7's offline Gemini is expected to reach the Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2, bringing an assistant that answers without a phone or network connection.

items.title: My Brief Summer Fling With Siri AI
items.excerpt: WIRED's writer fell for the Siri AI beta and then forgot it existed — a candid account of how Apple's revamped assistant fades out of daily phone use.

items.title: We need to talk about Siri AI for Apple Watch
items.excerpt: 9to5Mac argues Siri AI on Apple Watch, arriving two cycles late in the watchOS 27 beta, still misses what makes a wrist assistant worth using.
